_about: Evaluation dataset for source-grounded summaries. Source texts are real, unmodified official bill versions (see ingestion/tests/fixtures/README.md), except where a case is marked synthetic. Every candidate summary below is SYNTHETIC: hand-written to exercise the checks, not produced by a model and not reviewed for publication. required_facts lists what any correct summary of that version must convey; a summary's accuracy score is the share of required facts it covers with valid citations.

overview.text: HB 101 would require the state to provide Medicaid coverage to everyone who applies and for whom federal matching funds are available under the Affordable Care Act. It would only take effect if voters approve a related constitutional amendment.
